LanguageData.ARIO_SiegeEstablished: {0} is blockaded at every open entrance. Defenders have roughly {1} days of pantry rations, plus any physical food still on the map. Hold the gate or break through.
LanguageData.ARIO_SiegeLow: {0} is running low on provisions: about {1} days of pantry rations remain. Expect a stronger attempt to break the blockade.
LanguageData.ARIO_SiegeOut: {0}'s pantry reserves are exhausted. Remaining physical food may still sustain defenders; starving soldiers can now be defeated without an assault.
LanguageData.ARIO_SiegeOpen: {0}'s supply route is open again. The siege timer resets and provisions recover gradually; no existing map items are replaced.
LanguageData.ARIO_ReliefSpotted: A relief caravan carrying food for {0} has entered the map. Stop it before it reaches the castle pantry.
LanguageData.ARIO_ReliefSpottedTroops: A relief caravan carrying food and potential reinforcements for {0} has entered the map. Intercept it before it reaches the castle.
LanguageData.ARIO_ReliefDelivered: Relief supplies reached {0}. Real food was delivered inside the castle; any surviving reinforcements may join the defenders.
